name: SF Mobile Crisis Team
description: San Francisco Department of Public Health's Comprehensive Crisis Services (including the Mobile Crisis Team and Child Crisis) responds to mental health and substance use crises, with clinicians who can do outreach visits for adults and children.
fullDescription: San Francisco Department of Public Health's Comprehensive Crisis Services (including the Mobile Crisis Team and Child Crisis) responds to mental health and substance use crises, with clinicians who can do outreach visits for adults and children.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 crisis phone line
- Outreach visits during a mental health crisis for adults and children
- Crisis intervention and de-escalation
- Connection to appropriate services
howToGetIt: Call Comprehensive Crisis at 628-217-7000, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. For a life-threatening emergency or overdose, call 911.
keywords: SF Mobile Crisis Team, Comprehensive Crisis Services, psychiatric emergency, mental health emergency, crisis intervention, clinicians, child crisis
